picks.name: ODF
picks.source_note: New release on Shall Not Fade.
picks.bio: Olivier de Friend, a UKG and grooving-breaks specialist stepping into house territory. "The Rhythm Grooves" (August 28, 2026) is a four-track statement EP -- The Rhythm Grooves, Free Your Soul, Back To Mine, Do U Feel Me? -- marking his transfer to Shall Not Fade's main roster after two years of singles on his own On Da Floor label.
picks.why_listen: Classic US garage-house warmth filtered through a UKG producer's ear for groove -- solid, rolling material for a set's warmer stretches.

picks.name: Mata Disk
picks.bio: "MindBoggle" (July 31, 2026, cat. NOUS048) is a five-track EP on Nous'klaer Audio -- the release directly preceding the label's Oceanic "ICI" EP already featured here -- built around tracks like Chooser and Endworld.
picks.why_listen: Another solid, driving entry from the same Rotterdam camp as Oceanic -- good back-to-back material if you want to run a Nous'klaer-heavy stretch of a set.

picks.name: Mohamed Bourouissa
picks.bio: Algerian-born, Paris-based photographer, known for using the documentary medium to probe subtle systems of power. "LILA" (July 24, 2026) is his first extended musical work -- 12 tracks on PAN, each named after and inspired by people in his life.
picks.why_listen: Not a club record -- a surrealist, photographer's-ear take on ambient/experimental sound, in the same headphones-first vein as your Patrick Belaga pick from earlier this week.
